description: This file defines the AnnotationService class, which manages user annotations and reader UI preferences for a Flutter application. It handles local persistence via SQLite (sqflite) on mobile and desktop platforms, and in-memory storage with SharedPreferences for web platforms. The service provides methods for initialization, CRUD operations on annotations, and preference management such as font size and sidebar visibility.

classes.name: AnnotationService
classes.description: Singleton service class managing user annotations and UI preferences, supporting platform-specific persistence mechanisms.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database (for mobile/desktop) or prepares SharedPreferences (for web).

methods.name: _ensureDb
methods.description: Ensures the SQLite database is available; returns null on web.

methods.name: getByChapter
methods.description: Retrieves all annotations for a specific chapter, sorted by creation time.

methods.name: getByChapterSection
methods.description: Retrieves annotations for a chapter and optional section, sorted by start offset and creation time.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts a new annotation into the store; supports in-memory storage on web.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing annotation by id.

methods.name: clearForChapter
methods.description: Removes all annotations for a specified chapter.

methods.name: getFontSize
methods.description: Gets the stored font size preference, defaulting to 16.0.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Sets the font size preference, clamped between 10.0 and 36.0.

methods.name: getShowNotesSidebar
methods.description: Gets the boolean preference for notes sidebar visibility, default false.

methods.name: setShowNotesSidebar
methods.description: Sets the notes sidebar visibility preference.

methods.name: debugClearAll
methods.description: Clears all annotations; used for testing.

methods.name: debugClose
methods.description: Closes the database connection; used for testing.
